decisions.reason: The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already states that prize wins are announced on the Winners page and claimed with one click, so no additional or corrected MODIFY is needed.
The one-click collection flow changes how selected winners claim prizes, not the Chainlink VRF selection method, eligibility, weighting, or assurance.
The prize-claim interaction and location do not change the Big Block winner count, prize amount, pool target, draw trigger, funding, or eligible sale types.
The prize-claim interaction and location do not change the Small Block winner count, prize amount, pool amount, draw condition, or funding sources.
Winner collection occurs after selection and does not alter ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, weighting, or post-draw reset behavior.
The Winners-page claim flow does not change secondary-sale royalty amount, visibility, allocation, enforcement, or ticket-generation behavior.
The winner claim flow does not alter the mint price or the founder, referral, and prize-pool allocations from primary mints.
The prize collection interaction does not change which book, referral code, badges, or expired-ticket state transfers with an NFT resale.
A one-click claim on the Winners page does not necessarily change unauthenticated access to public leaderboards or pool values.
The claim location and interaction do not change the NFT metadata fields for ticket counters, permanent badges, or the mint-number referral code.
Prize claiming does not change badge definitions, milestones, storage, icons, or their cosmetic and leaderboard effects.
The Winners-page claim flow does not change the selected Base blockchain or Ethereum L2 deployment target.
